scope: Authority behind the FE/BE no-Stocktake guard in the current MVP runtime
summary: The guard is anchored to REQ-SRS-037 in the adopted SRS/FRD v1.12 baseline, not to a standalone approved Decision ID. DEC-NO-STOCKTAKE-001 exists only as a decision row inside that baseline; the independent Decision Record WWHN-25 / DEC-STK-001 is still In Progress, so it is never cited as approved governance.

controllingRequirement.statement: Khong expose Stocktake/Variance, menu/API/permission/entity/report hoac action sua ton truc tiep.

anchors.decisionRow: DEC-NO-STOCKTAKE-001 in section 2 Decision Records and Governance
anchors.supersessionRow: Stocktake va hanh dong sua ton truc tiep -> DEC-NO-STOCKTAKE-001 -> SUPERSEDED 04/08/2026
anchors.traceabilityRow: SRC-008 / DEC-NO-STOCKTAKE-001 -> REQ-SRS-037 -> BR-NOSTK-01..03 -> AC-SRS-037 -> TC-SRS-037

decisionRowFields.decisionDate: 04/08/2026 confirmation; SRS adoption: WWHN-334; formal Decision: WWHN-25 only.

adoption.title: [DOC][BA][SRS/FRD] Tai lieu Dac ta Yeu cau Phan mem / Yeu cau Chuc nang
adoption.effectiveDateRule: SRS section 0.1: effective date is the WWHN-334 transition to DONE; no retroactive effective date.
adoption.openConditions: Latest WWHN-334 review is conditional PASS (80/100) with OP-01/OP-05/OP-09 still open. None of those open points concern Stocktake.

corroboratingBaselines.anchor: Section 0.1 Entity/field bi loai khoi baseline: khong tao Stocktake_Session, Stocktake_Snapshot, Stocktake_Count, Variance_Line, Adjustment hoac report/permission tuong ung.
No Stocktake/Variance screen, menu entry or stock-edit action exists in the aligned wireframe.

correctionAuthority.rule: Correction after Post is append-only Reversal only; there is no generic or direct stock-edit movement.

decisionRecordGate.title: [DEC-STK-001] Lap Decision Record ve mo hinh kiem ke A
decisionRecordGate.note: DEC-NO-STOCKTAKE-001 must not be cited as an approved standalone Decision ID while WWHN-25 is In Progress. That does not weaken the guard: the controlling requirement REQ-SRS-037 already lives in the adopted SRS/FRD v1.12 baseline and is corroborated by the ERD and wireframe baselines.
decisionRecordGate.closureEvidence: Approver-authored disposition on WWHN-25 naming the exact artifact revision/hash.

runtimeRule.currentBehavior: No Stocktake Session/Snapshot/Count/Variance surface, no stocktake.* permission, no route/menu, no direct stock-edit endpoint in FE or BE runtime.
runtimeRule.guardPurpose: Regression guard: keep FE/BE source consistent with REQ-SRS-037 and the ERD/wireframe baselines so a stale historical artifact cannot silently reintroduce a removed surface. It is not a claim of standalone Decision Record approval.
runtimeRule.reintroductionGate: Approved Later Phase / Change Request / closed WWHN-25 Decision Record, plus synchronized FE/BE/OpenAPI/RBAC/test updates.

closurePolicy: Source/implementation consistency is machine-verified by npm run check:api-mapping and npm run wwhn-296:verify. Formal Decision Record closure stays external on WWHN-25 and is never marked VERIFIED from FE source.
